scenario.description: A conversation unfolds about organizing a weekend getaway.

agent_a.name: Leo

profile.personality_and_values: Leo Williams, despite being quiet, values security and care for others. He's a rational decision-maker focussing on best outcomes.
profile.public_info: Leo Williams often spends his time playing with his young daughter whom he cherishes dearly.

agent_a.goal: Convince the friend to join the trip (<extra_info>Extra information: the trip will be more fun with more people, and you can share the expenses. <strategy_hint>Hint: you can provide some material benefits to persuade your friend to join.</strategy_hint></extra_info>)

agent_b.name: Hendrick

profile.personality_and_values: Hendrick Heinz, though somewhat impulsive, values hedonism and conformity. He combines practicality with decisiveness in decision-making.
profile.public_info: Hendrick Heinz hosts monthly wine tasting nights with his peers.

agent_b.goal: Decline the invitation to join the trip without upsetting the friend (<extra_info>Extra information: you had other plans for the weekend.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Hendrick wants to decline the trip so that he can stick to his existing weekend plans without upsetting Leo.
